mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This relationship is consistent with the inverse link between interest rates and equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI index above 230 signals high inflation, prompting monetary tightening expectations that depress equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 230, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market conditions (high PAYEMS and low UNRATE) indicate robust economic growth, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to elevated corporate earnings.
failure_condition: The joint signal of high PAYEMS and low UNRATE fails to predict positive returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as economic growth decelerates.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during late-cycle expansions when HOUST declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to immediate economic concerns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 95.0, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending, which drives corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS is above 400,000, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low interest rates (FEDFUNDS) and low unemployment (UNRATE) signals an accommodative monetary policy and tight labor market, which together drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through elevated economic growth expectations.
failure_condition: The joint signal of low FEDFUNDS and low UNRATE fails to predict positive returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 230), a further increase in CPIAUCSL signals imminent monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to rapid policy response.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 230, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
